n: Berkeley Language Center Language and AI machine translation resources
t: Open activity templates on using machine translation and AI for language learning.
steps: Find the Language and AI pages on the Berkeley Language Center site.
Download a template. The preview links are view-only.
Pick a proficiency level and a goal.
Adapt the template to your language.
Choose the translation tools your school allows.
Check the privacy terms of those tools.
Try the activity yourself before class.
